en: Screen insets fixed for punch-hole camera and status bar visibility
Polished first-launch flow: Language selection, 3 walkthrough slides, Theme setup
In-app update notifications for new releases
Live bus tracking with real-time ETA countdowns and leave-now advice
Bilingual English & Kannada interface across all screens
3 cohesive WCAG-compliant themes: Light, Dark, and Blue
